latestVersion.changelog:
OpusClip 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered tool to extract viral short clips from long-form videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Cloud-based workflow: upload, generate, edit, and export short clips in high-quality 1080p MP4 format.
- Supports credit-based access with free registration (100 credits; 7-day expiry per token).
- Automatic session setup and streamlined user experience, including error handling and progress updates.
- Compatible with popular video formats and platforms; ideal for content creators and marketers.
